title: Add live drift coverage for state verification
summary: Extend `covenant verify --json` live coverage to prove a real daemon reports non-zero drift with actionable repair hints after durable state is mutated out of band.
expectedFailureModes: The verifier prints a clean JSON envelope for healthy state but exits zero when drift exists.
Drift rows omit repair guidance, leaving autonomous supervisors with a failure signal but no recovery path.
Live coverage claims state-verifier drift handling without crossing the daemon, SQLite memory, audit log, and CLI boundaries.
verification: cd agent-os && cargo test -p covenantd --test live_cli_verify_json --locked -- --ignored live_
nextAction: Add a live drift fixture for `verify --json`, update the coverage matrix, and validate that non-zero drift exits non-zero with repair guidance.
